decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION-BRANCH READ (owner decision 184; level 2; claim ceiling 'nominated', ruling O1). Per branch (a-agree delivering, b-top2contrast, t-twin): the sealed branch note's candidate list gives gold's rank (1/2/3/absent), top1 and present offline (gold enters only offline); the branch's level-2 first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (score_complete_derived_copy); A's column is A's own first Solver answer. Every contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929); the utterance-level number is reported beside and never gates. (1) THE TWIN NULL: T minus A per metric; the bar = |T - A offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the provisional floor 0.3163 pp. (2) THE CONTRAST: b-top2contrast minus A on the level-2 branch Solver column's official intent accuracy (primary). NOMINATED iff the intent CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds the twin's intent bar AND the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound of the same column is not below minus the twin's SLU bar (guard). BRANCH-LOCAL HARM iff the intent CI95 upper bound is below zero and the point magnitude exceeds the twin bar. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED. Reported beside, never gating: gold-on-list and mean gold rank of the B note vs A and T, the conversion P(correct | gold rank r in the branch note) against the ledger's 97.57 / 26.98 / 12.0 %, the rows where top2-contrast-v1 rendered nothing (presentation_skip_reason, ruling O5), and the delivered row (identical by construction). A nomination sends the composed policy to a full-system cross-flight read against an in-chain A/A; it admits nothing.
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold B development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: branch b-top2contrast: presentation_id top2-contrast-v1; the Fold B re-target and the program switch to phase-native-candidates-review-revise-pbranch3-l2-v1 are the instrument's carrier, shared by every branch
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact or read (Fold A is the tuning roster and is not re-flown).
No re-flying of the sealed AGREE arm.
No second factor: one axis on the B branch, none on A or T.
No flight before root mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No branch score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a branch effect may only nominate (ruling O1).
No branch value built from Fold B rollouts (owner decision 186).
the_question: At the one Perception visit of every TRAIN Fold B row, does rendering the branch's rank-1/rank-2 candidate pair as a top-2 contrast block (top2-contrast-v1) move the level-2 branch Solver column's official intent accuracy beyond the in-flight twin's null, read against the delivering branch A (AGREE's Perception evidence as flown) in the same flight?
